name: wise-cli
description: Unofficial CLI for Wise (TransferWise) with browser-based 2FA authentication
author: Tiago Morais

scripts.compile: bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 src/index.ts --outfile dist/wise-linux-x64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 src/index.ts --outfile dist/wise-darwin-arm64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 src/index.ts --outfile dist/wise-windows-x64.exe
